title: Ruleset: save
description: rules/<id>/save.yaml: when the game saves by itself (game/save: AutosaveRules, docs/architecture/save.md). The original never autosaved: every flag false is its behaviour.

on_battle_end.description: Autosave after every battle, won or lost.

on_partner_sleep.description: Autosave when the partner goes to sleep.

on_new_day.description: Autosave on every new day of the game clock.
